audit_items.proof_trace: The LatestExecutionPayloadHeader is reconstructed by extracting fields via interface methods and creating a new ExecutionPayloadHeaderDeneb struct. If pre-state contains a future header version with additional fields beyond Deneb, those fields are silently dropped during reconstruction, violating the property that all fields except fork and proposer_lookahead are preserved.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If UpgradeToFulu is invoked on a pre-state with a non-Electra execution payload header (e.g., containing future fork-specific fields), the reconstruction at lines 142-160 only captures Deneb-era fields, causing silent data loss that could lead to consensus divergence between validators processing the same upgrade.
